Experimental. An Arista EOS switch's hostname. Removing this step leaves the name as it is.

**Experimental.** Network devices are new, and this module may change between releases. It's tested against cEOS-lab 4.37.0F on a local machine, not yet in CI.

Use `eos_hostname` to name an Arista EOS switch. The change goes through a config session with a revert timer, like every EOS step, including the wait before the confirm: about 30 seconds per step in v0.9.0, and once per switch from the next release; see [`eos_config`](/modules/eos_config).

## Example usage

```hcl
step "name" {
  eos_hostname {
    name = each.key
  }
}
```

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | Yes | Hostname, such as leaf1. EOS takes letters, digits, hyphens and dots. |

## Read-only attributes

Conn3x sets these; reference them as `conn3x_eos_hostname.<circuit>__<step>["<host>"].<name>`.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `in_sync` | bool | Whether the switch had this name at the last refresh. |
| `revision` | string | Changes each time Conn3x changes this on the host. Handlers watch it. |

A step lowers to the `conn3x_eos_hostname` resource, one instance per host, and connects with its circuit's `ssh` block.
